blocked: The status change from {{fromStatus}} to {{toStatus}} was blocked by a workflow: {{reasons}}

reasons.entityLoadFailed: could not load {{entityType}} {{entityId}} to evaluate the rule
reasons.entityNotFound: {{entityType}} {{entityId}} was not found, so the rule can't be evaluated
reasons.whereEvaluationFailed: the WHERE clause of policy '{{policyName}}' could not be evaluated on {{entityType}} {{entityId}}

requiresTransition: An edit can't change the status from {{fromStatus}} to {{toStatus}}. Use Change Status, which checks the transition and runs the status change workflows.
certifiedIsNotAStatus: Certified is not a status: certification is set with Certify, on an active entity.
invalidStatus: {{status}} is not a lifecycle status. Use one of: {{allowed}}.
gateError: The status change from {{fromStatus}} to {{toStatus}} was refused: the workflow gate {{workflows}} could not be evaluated. Ask an administrator to check the workflow.
gateErrorUnnamed: The status change from {{fromStatus}} to {{toStatus}} was refused: a workflow gate could not be evaluated. Ask an administrator to check the workflow.
certifiedDeprecationRequiresApproval: {{name}} is certified, so it can only be deprecated through an approved status change request. Request the status change instead.

certifiedGuard.title: Certified deprecation guard
certifiedGuard.description: A certified data product or data contract can only be deprecated through an approved status change request. The guard applies everywhere unless you switch it off below.
certifiedGuard.hint: The guard doesn't apply to the domains, data products and data contracts listed here (a domain covers its products and contracts): their certified entities deprecate directly. Each skip is logged and audited.
certifiedGuard.saveFailed: The certified deprecation guard couldn't be saved
certifiedGuard.loadFailed: The certified deprecation guard couldn't be loaded
certifiedGuard.notFound: {{id}} no longer exists. Remove it and save again.
certifiedGuard.missingOnSave_one: The guard is switched off for {{count}} item that no longer exists. Remove it and save again.
certifiedGuard.missingOnSave_other: The guard is switched off for {{count}} items that no longer exist. Remove them and save again.
certifiedGuard.readOnly: Only admins of certification levels can change the guard.

certifiedApprovalRefused.not_admin: {{name}} is certified: only an admin of this feature can approve its deprecation.
certifiedApprovalRefused.no_pending_request: {{name}} is certified: approving needs a pending status change request for this change, and there is none.
certifiedApprovalRefused.target_mismatch: {{name}} is certified: the pending request asks for another status, so this approval doesn't apply to it.
certifiedApprovalRefused.self_approval: {{name}} is certified: you made this request, so someone else has to approve it.
certifiedApprovalRefused.no_approver: {{name}} is certified: its deprecation needs a decision by an approver of the request.
